country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
summary: Restoration and mixed land pledges include peatland restoration across hundreds of thousands of hectares, 9,000 hectares of new woodland in Northern Ireland by 2030, and at least 45,000 miles of managed hedgerows in England by 2050. Mixed woodland targets are 16.5% woodland/tree-canopy cover in England and 12% woodland cover in Northern Ireland, both by 2050. The 9,000 hectares equal 90 km², roughly 0.5% of the UK’s 18,799 km² forest area, though the target applies to Northern Ireland. Conservation combines protection of 30% of land and sea by 2030, highly protected marine areas by 2026, and halting species-abundance decline by 2030. Agriculture has a 10-year food-and-drinks strategy and domestic methane action, but no quantified farm-area target against the country’s 71,415 km² of agricultural land. Cross-cutting goals include halting deforestation and degradation by 2030; nature-related finance includes £750 million, at least £3 billion in 2021/22–2025/26, and £1.5 billion for forests.
